notes:
Create a Song now shares Local Radio production notes for short genre requests. Conversational wording such as make me a Detroit rap song receives the same programmed drum and 808 direction as the genre label. Radio continues to reuse notes per station, while one-off songs derive their own directions.

Submitted Detroit rap through the Create Song form, verified that vocals were selected automatically, and completed a two-minute recording. A separate instrumental UK garage recording exercised local production-note generation outside a radio station. All 16 adapter tests passed, including specific tempos, fusions and instrumental beats.
